data.body: Disposable operational rehearsal found a pre-window blocker in the existing AUTO-RECOVER orphan path: all 9 orphan rebuilds succeeded and created 9 local commits in 144.77s, but origin/tickets remained at the old tip and fsck reported PUSH_PENDING by 9. Cause: `_repair_run` lets `rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log` self-commit, so the batch driver sees no staged diff and never enters its push block. This contradicts the already-documented batched commit-and-push contract required by this ticket. No authoritative store was touched. I am adding a real-Git regression and changing only the driver call to defer all rebuild commits to its existing batch commit/push block; direct `_repair_ticket` behavior remains compatible.
